-- Axentra database roles, run once by the postgres image on first initialization
-- (/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d, as the superuser, connected to $POSTGRES_DB).
--
-- axentra_owner  owns the schema and runs migrations (`axentra migrate`).
-- axentra_app    is what the API uses at runtime: no superuser, no BYPASSRLS, no DDL, only
--                SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on tables created by axentra_owner. Row-level
--                security therefore applies to every query of the API (Axentra refuses to start in
--                production with a role that bypasses RLS).
--
-- Passwords come from the container environment (AXENTRA_DB_OWNER_PASSWORD, AXENTRA_DB_APP_PASSWORD),
-- read with psql's \getenv (psql >= 15). Use URL-safe values (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`), since they
-- are also embedded in connection URLs. For an existing server, run the same statements manually.

\set ON_ERROR_STOP on
\getenv owner_password AXENTRA_DB_OWNER_PASSWORD
\getenv app_password AXENTRA_DB_APP_PASSWORD

\if :{?owner_password}
\else
DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AXENTRA_DB_OWNER_PASSWORD is not set'; END $$

\endif
\if :{?app_password}
\else
DO $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AXENTRA_DB_APP_PASSWORD is not set'; END $$

\endif

SELECT current_database() AS dbname \gset

CREATE ROLE axentra_owner LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS
    PASSWORD :'owner_password'

CREATE ROLE axentra_app LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS
    PASSWORD :'app_password'

-- The owner role owns the database and therefore (PostgreSQL 15+) the public schema.
ALTER DATABASE :"dbname" OWNER TO axentra_owner
ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO axentra_owner
REVOKE ALL ON DATABASE :"dbname" FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA public FROM PUBLIC
GRANT CONNECT, TEMPORARY ON DATABASE :"dbname" TO axentra_app
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO axentra_app

-- Everything the owner creates later (migrations of Axentra and of product namespaces) is usable,
-- but not alterable, by the application role.
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE axentra_owner IN SCHEMA public
    GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES TO axentra_app

ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE axentra_owner IN SCHEMA public
    GRANT USAGE, SELECT ON SEQUENCES TO axentra_app

ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES FOR ROLE axentra_owner IN SCHEMA public
    GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTIONS TO axentra_app

-- Example product migration (namespace "crm"), used by docs/guides/PRODUCT_TABLES.md and
-- exercised by tests/integration/test_product_tables_guide.py.
-- Prefix every object with the product namespace; never touch axentra_* objects except to
-- reference axentra_tenants / axentra_products and to call axentra_scope_allows().

CREATE TABLE crm_deals (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    title text NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    stage text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (stage IN ('open', 'won', 'lost')),
    amount_cents bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (amount_cents >= 0),
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    -- Deleting the tenant (or the product) deletes its deals.
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
-- Every list query filters by product and tenant first; keyset pagination uses id.
CREATE INDEX crm_deals_list ON crm_deals (product_id, tenant_id, id);
CREATE INDEX crm_deals_stage ON crm_deals (product_id, tenant_id, stage);

-- Row-level security: rows are visible and writable only inside their product/tenant scope.
-- FORCE also applies the policy to the table owner (the migration role).
ALTER TABLE crm_deals ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE crm_deals FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON crm_deals
    USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))
    WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

-- Taskboard schema, migration namespace "taskboard" (registered with ax.register_migrations).
-- Every object is prefixed with taskboard_; Axentra's tables are only referenced, never altered.
-- Pattern: docs/guides/PRODUCT_TABLES.md (product_id + tenant_id, FK to axentra_tenants with
-- ON DELETE CASCADE, ENABLE + FORCE row-level security with axentra_scope_allows()).

CREATE TABLE taskboard_projects (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(description) <= 5000),
    archived boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    -- Deleting the workspace (tenant) or the product deletes its projects.
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- Target of the tasks' composite foreign key (a task's project is always in the same tenant).
    UNIQUE (product_id, tenant_id, id)
);
CREATE INDEX taskboard_projects_list ON taskboard_projects (product_id, tenant_id, id);

CREATE TABLE taskboard_tasks (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    project_id text NOT NULL,
    title text NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 300),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(description) <= 20000),
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'todo' CHECK (status IN ('todo', 'doing', 'done')),
    assignee_id text,
    due_date date,
    -- Optional client-supplied Idempotency-Key of the create request (unique per tenant).
    idempotency_key text CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- Deleting a project deletes its tasks; a task cannot point at another tenant's project.
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id, project_id)
        REFERENCES taskboard_projects (product_id, tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (product_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key)
);
CREATE INDEX taskboard_tasks_by_project ON taskboard_tasks (product_id, tenant_id, project_id, id);
CREATE INDEX taskboard_tasks_by_status ON taskboard_tasks (product_id, tenant_id, status);

-- Row-level security: rows are visible and writable only inside their product/tenant scope.
-- FORCE applies the policies to the table owner (the migration role) as well.
ALTER TABLE taskboard_projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE taskboard_projects FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON taskboard_projects
    USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))
    WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

ALTER TABLE taskboard_tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE taskboard_tasks FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON taskboard_tasks
    USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))
    WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

-- Axentra foundation schema: products, identity, tenancy, access, audit, records.
-- Row-level security (RLS) is enabled and FORCED on every product/tenant table; see
-- docs/architecture/SECURITY_MODEL.md. The application sets axentra.scope, axentra.product_id
-- and axentra.tenant_id per transaction (axentra.data.database.Database.transaction).

CREATE FUNCTION axentra_scope_allows(p text, t text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE current_setting('axentra.scope', true)
        WHEN 'platform' THEN true
        WHEN 'product' THEN p IS NOT NULL AND p = current_setting('axentra.product_id', true)
        WHEN 'tenant' THEN p IS NOT NULL AND p = current_setting('axentra.product_id', true)
            AND (t IS NULL OR t = current_setting('axentra.tenant_id', true))
        ELSE false
    END
$$

CREATE TABLE axentra_products (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    slug text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}$'),
    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived')),
    settings jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
ALTER TABLE axentra_products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_products FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_products USING (axentra_scope_allows(id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(id, NULL))

-- Users are global identities. A user sees and acts in a product only through memberships.
CREATE TABLE axentra_users (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    email text NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled')),
    password_hash text,
    locale text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
    preferences jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_login_at timestamptz
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX axentra_users_email ON axentra_users (lower(email))

CREATE TABLE axentra_user_identities (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    provider text NOT NULL,
    subject text NOT NULL,
    email text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (provider, subject)
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_user_identities_user ON axentra_user_identities (user_id)

CREATE TABLE axentra_platform_roles (
    user_id text PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role text NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('platform_admin', 'platform_viewer')),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)

CREATE TABLE axentra_sessions (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    csrf_token text NOT NULL,
    auth_method text NOT NULL,
    ip text,
    user_agent text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_seen_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    revoked_at timestamptz
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_sessions_user ON axentra_sessions (user_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE axentra_login_states (
    state_hash text PRIMARY KEY,
    provider text NOT NULL,
    nonce text NOT NULL,
    code_verifier text NOT NULL,
    return_to text NOT NULL DEFAULT '/',
    invitation_token text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE axentra_setup_tokens (
    token_hash text PRIMARY KEY,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    used_at timestamptz
)

-- Fixed-window counters for login throttling, shared by all API processes.
CREATE TABLE axentra_rate_limits (
    bucket text NOT NULL,
    window_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    hits integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (bucket, window_start)
)

CREATE TABLE axentra_product_members (
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role text NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, user_id)
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_product_members_user ON axentra_product_members (user_id)
ALTER TABLE axentra_product_members ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_product_members FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_product_members USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL))

CREATE TABLE axentra_tenants (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    slug text NOT NULL CHECK (slug ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,62}$'),
    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'suspended')),
    settings jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (product_id, slug),
    UNIQUE (product_id, id)
)

ALTER TABLE axentra_tenants FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_tenants USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, id))

CREATE TABLE axentra_memberships (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    role text NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id)
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_memberships_user ON axentra_memberships (user_id)
ALTER TABLE axentra_memberships ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_memberships FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_memberships USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

CREATE TABLE axentra_invitations (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    email text NOT NULL,
    role text NOT NULL,
    token_hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    invited_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    accepted_at timestamptz,
    accepted_by text,
    revoked_at timestamptz,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CREATE INDEX axentra_invitations_tenant ON axentra_invitations (product_id, tenant_id)
ALTER TABLE axentra_invitations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_invitations FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_invitations USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Custom roles of a product (built-in roles live in code, axentra.access.permissions).
CREATE TABLE axentra_roles (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key text NOT NULL CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$'),
    name text NOT NULL,
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scope text NOT NULL CHECK (scope IN ('product', 'tenant')),
    permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (product_id, key)

ALTER TABLE axentra_roles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_roles FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_roles USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL))

CREATE TABLE axentra_api_keys (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tenant_id text,
    name text NOT NULL,
    secret_hash text NOT NULL,
    permissions text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    last_used_at timestamptz,
    expires_at timestamptz,
    revoked_at timestamptz,
    replaces text,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_api_keys_product ON axentra_api_keys (product_id)
ALTER TABLE axentra_api_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_api_keys FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_api_keys USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Append-only audit trail. Platform events have no product.
CREATE TABLE axentra_audit_events (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    product_id text,
    tenant_id text,
    actor_kind text NOT NULL,
    actor_id text NOT NULL,
    actor_display text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action text NOT NULL,
    target_type text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    target_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'success' CHECK (outcome IN ('success', 'denied', 'failure')),
    request_id text,
    ip text,
    details jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_audit_events_time ON axentra_audit_events (occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX axentra_audit_events_product ON axentra_audit_events (product_id, occurred_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX axentra_audit_events_action ON axentra_audit_events (action)
ALTER TABLE axentra_audit_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_audit_events FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_audit_events USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id) OR (product_id IS NULL AND current_setting('axentra.scope', true) = 'platform'))
    WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id) OR product_id IS NULL)

CREATE TABLE axentra_records (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    collection text NOT NULL CHECK (collection ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$'),
    data jsonb NOT NULL,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by text,
    updated_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_records_list ON axentra_records (product_id, tenant_id, collection, id)
CREATE INDEX axentra_records_data ON axentra_records USING gin (data jsonb_path_ops)
ALTER TABLE axentra_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_records FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

-- Axentra events module: persistent job queue, schedules, events (transactional outbox),
-- outgoing webhooks and deliveries. See docs/modules/EVENTS_AND_JOBS.md.
-- Every table carries product_id (and tenant_id where a row belongs to a tenant) and has
-- row-level security ENABLED and FORCED with the scope policy of migration 0001.
--
-- Stream positions: streamed rows (events, job status changes) get a position from
-- axentra_stream_seq only AFTER they committed, assigned by one assigner at a time (transaction
-- advisory lock; see axentra.events.streams). Positions therefore follow commit order and a reader
-- resuming after position N never misses a row that commits later.

CREATE SEQUENCE axentra_stream_seq

CREATE TABLE axentra_jobs (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tenant_id text,
    tenant_key text GENERATED ALWAYS AS (coalesce(tenant_id, '')) STORED,
    kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]{0,99}$'),
    payload jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued'
        CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'dead', 'cancelled')),
    priority integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (priority BETWEEN -100 AND 100),
    run_after timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    max_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5 CHECK (max_attempts BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    backoff_base_seconds double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 2,
    backoff_max_seconds double precision NOT NULL DEFAULT 3600,
    lease_until timestamptz,
    worker text,
    cancel_requested boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    last_error text,
    idempotency_key text CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    result jsonb,
    schedule_id text,
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

CREATE INDEX axentra_jobs_list ON axentra_jobs (product_id, id DESC)

CREATE TABLE axentra_schedules (

CREATE INDEX axentra_schedules_due ON axentra_schedules (next_run_at) WHERE enabled
CREATE INDEX axentra_schedules_product ON axentra_schedules (product_id, id)
ALTER TABLE axentra_schedules ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_schedules FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_schedules USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Every slot of a schedule fires at most once (primary key), also when two schedulers overlap.

ALTER TABLE axentra_schedule_firings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_schedule_firings USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

CREATE TABLE axentra_events (

CREATE INDEX axentra_events_list ON axentra_events (product_id, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX axentra_events_tenant ON axentra_events (product_id, tenant_id, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX axentra_events_stream ON axentra_events (product_id, pos)

ALTER TABLE axentra_webhook_endpoints FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

-- Storage module: file metadata, per-tenant quotas and usage counters.
-- File bytes live in the configured object storage backend (local directory or S3) under a key
-- derived only from ids: <product_id>/<tenant_id>/<file_id>. RLS is enabled and FORCED on every
-- table, like in 0001.

CREATE TABLE axentra_files (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),
    content_type text NOT NULL,
    size bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (size >= 0),
    sha256 text CHECK (sha256 IS NULL OR sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    storage_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    backend text NOT NULL,
    metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'active', 'deleted')),
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_by text,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz,
    deleted_at timestamptz,
    -- Set once the backend confirmed the object deletion; NULL on deleted rows means "retry".
    object_deleted_at timestamptz,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX axentra_files_list ON axentra_files (product_id, tenant_id, created_at, id) WHERE status = 'active'
CREATE INDEX axentra_files_expiry ON axentra_files (expires_at) WHERE status = 'active' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX axentra_files_pending ON axentra_files (created_at) WHERE status = 'pending'
CREATE INDEX axentra_files_unpurged ON axentra_files (deleted_at) WHERE status = 'deleted' AND object_deleted_at IS NULL
ALTER TABLE axentra_files ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_files FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_files USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Per-tenant quota overrides. NULL means "inherit" (product settings storage.quota_bytes /
-- storage.quota_files, then the installation default, then unlimited).
CREATE TABLE axentra_storage_quotas (
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    quota_bytes bigint CHECK (quota_bytes IS NULL OR quota_bytes >= 0),
    quota_files integer CHECK (quota_files IS NULL OR quota_files >= 0),
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    updated_by text,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, tenant_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
ALTER TABLE axentra_storage_quotas ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_storage_quotas FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_storage_quotas USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Usage counters of active files. Uploads lock this row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE) while checking the
-- quota, so concurrent uploads of one tenant serialize on it and cannot overshoot the quota.
CREATE TABLE axentra_storage_usage (
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    bytes_used bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (bytes_used >= 0),
    files_used integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (files_used >= 0),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, tenant_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
ALTER TABLE axentra_storage_usage ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE axentra_storage_usage FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_storage_usage USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id))

-- Usage metering (meters, idempotent events, aggregated counters, quotas, reservations) and
-- billing (plans with prices and entitlements, tenant subscriptions, entitlement overrides,
-- processed provider webhook events). Axentra never stores card data.
-- RLS: every table is ENABLED + FORCED with the axentra_scope_allows policy (see 0001).

-- == Usage ======================================================================================

CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_meters (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key text NOT NULL CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,62}$'),
    name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(name) <= 200),
    unit text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(unit) <= 40),
    aggregation text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sum' CHECK (aggregation IN ('sum', 'max', 'last')),
    reset_period text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month' CHECK (reset_period IN ('none', 'day', 'month', 'billing_period')),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(description) <= 2000),
    default_limit numeric CHECK (default_limit IS NULL OR default_limit >= 0),
    default_enforcement text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hard' CHECK (default_enforcement IN ('hard', 'soft')),
    active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (product_id, key),
    UNIQUE (product_id, id)
);
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_meters ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_meters FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_meters USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL));

-- Append-only usage events. The idempotency key is unique per tenant; request_hash detects a
-- reused key with a different body.
CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_events (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    meter_id text NOT NULL,
    quantity numeric NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0),
    idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    request_hash text NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    properties jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    reservation_id text,
    actor_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, meter_id) REFERENCES axentra_usage_meters (product_id, id),
    UNIQUE (product_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key)
);
CREATE INDEX axentra_usage_events_list ON axentra_usage_events (product_id, tenant_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC);
CREATE INDEX axentra_usage_events_meter ON axentra_usage_events (product_id, meter_id);
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_events ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_events FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_events USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

-- Aggregates, updated in the same transaction as the event. granularity 'period' rows follow the
-- meter's reset period (and serve as the lock row for quota checks); 'day' rows feed time series.
CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_counters (
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    meter_id text NOT NULL,
    granularity text NOT NULL CHECK (granularity IN ('period', 'day')),
    period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    period_end timestamptz,
    value numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    event_count bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_at timestamptz,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, tenant_id, meter_id, granularity, period_start),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, meter_id) REFERENCES axentra_usage_meters (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX axentra_usage_counters_product ON axentra_usage_counters (product_id, meter_id, granularity, period_start);
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_counters ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_counters FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_counters USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

-- Per-tenant quota overrides. Without a row the limit comes from the plan entitlements (billing)
-- or the meter default. limit_value NULL = unlimited.
CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_quotas (
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    meter_id text NOT NULL,
    limit_value numeric CHECK (limit_value IS NULL OR limit_value >= 0),
    enforcement text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hard' CHECK (enforcement IN ('hard', 'soft')),
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    updated_by text,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, tenant_id, meter_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, meter_id) REFERENCES axentra_usage_meters (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_quotas ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_quotas FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_quotas USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_reservations (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    meter_id text NOT NULL,
    quantity numeric NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'committed', 'released', 'expired')),
    period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    idempotency_key text,
    request_hash text,
    event_id text,
    committed_quantity numeric,
    created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, meter_id) REFERENCES axentra_usage_meters (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE (product_id, tenant_id, idempotency_key)
);
CREATE INDEX axentra_usage_reservations_active ON axentra_usage_reservations (product_id, tenant_id, meter_id, period_start)
    WHERE status = 'active';
CREATE INDEX axentra_usage_reservations_expiry ON axentra_usage_reservations (expires_at) WHERE status = 'active';
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_reservations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_reservations FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_reservations USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

-- == Billing ====================================================================================

-- prices: [{"id": "prc_...", "amount_minor": 900, "currency": "EUR", "interval": "month",
--           "provider_price_id": "price_..."}]; entitlements: {"feature.x": true, "limit.api_calls": 10000}
CREATE TABLE axentra_billing_plans (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key text NOT NULL CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,62}$'),
    name text NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(description) <= 2000),
    active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    trial_days integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (trial_days BETWEEN 0 AND 365),
    prices jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    entitlements jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (product_id, key),
    UNIQUE (product_id, id)
);
ALTER TABLE axentra_billing_plans ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_billing_plans FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_billing_plans USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL));

CREATE TABLE axentra_billing_subscriptions (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    plan_id text NOT NULL,
    price jsonb,
    status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'incomplete')),
    period_anchor timestamptz NOT NULL,
    current_period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    current_period_end timestamptz NOT NULL,
    trial_end timestamptz,
    cancel_at_period_end boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    canceled_at timestamptz,
    provider text NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('manual', 'fake', 'stripe')),
    provider_customer_id text,
    provider_subscription_id text,
    provider_checkout_id text,
    last_provider_event_at timestamptz,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, plan_id) REFERENCES axentra_billing_plans (product_id, id)
);
-- At most one subscription per tenant that is not canceled.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX axentra_billing_subscriptions_current ON axentra_billing_subscriptions (product_id, tenant_id)
    WHERE status <> 'canceled';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX axentra_billing_subscriptions_provider_sub ON axentra_billing_subscriptions (provider, provider_subscription_id)
    WHERE provider_subscription_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX axentra_billing_subscriptions_provider_checkout ON axentra_billing_subscriptions (provider, provider_checkout_id)
    WHERE provider_checkout_id IS NOT NULL;
CREATE INDEX axentra_billing_subscriptions_list ON axentra_billing_subscriptions (product_id, created_at DESC, id DESC);
ALTER TABLE axentra_billing_subscriptions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE axentra_billing_subscriptions FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_billing_subscriptions USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, tenant_id));

CREATE TABLE axentra_billing_overrides (
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    entitlements jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    updated_by text,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id, tenant_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- Usage metering (meters, idempotent events, aggregated counters, quotas, reservations) and
-- billing (plans with prices and entitlements, tenant subscriptions, entitlement overrides,
-- processed provider webhook events). Axentra never stores card data.
-- RLS: every table is ENABLED + FORCED with the axentra_scope_allows policy (see 0001).

-- == Usage ======================================================================================

CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_meters (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_products (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key text NOT NULL CHECK (key ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,62}$'),
    name text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(name) <= 200),
    unit text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(unit) <= 40),
    aggregation text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sum' CHECK (aggregation IN ('sum', 'max', 'last')),
    reset_period text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'month' CHECK (reset_period IN ('none', 'day', 'month', 'billing_period')),
    description text NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (length(description) <= 2000),
    default_limit numeric CHECK (default_limit IS NULL OR default_limit >= 0),
    default_enforcement text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'hard' CHECK (default_enforcement IN ('hard', 'soft')),
    active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (product_id, key),
    UNIQUE (product_id, id)
)

ALTER TABLE axentra_usage_meters FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
CREATE POLICY scope ON axentra_usage_meters USING (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL)) WITH CHECK (axentra_scope_allows(product_id, NULL))

-- Append-only usage events. The idempotency key is unique per tenant; request_hash detects a
-- reused key with a different body.
CREATE TABLE axentra_usage_events (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id text NOT NULL,
    tenant_id text NOT NULL,
    meter_id text NOT NULL,
    quantity numeric NOT NULL CHECK (quantity >= 0),
    idempotency_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
    request_hash text NOT NULL,
    occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    period_start timestamptz NOT NULL,
    properties jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    reservation_id text,
    actor_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES axentra_tenants (product_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id, meter_id) REFERENCES axentra_usage_meters (product_id, id),

    roles text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',

    applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

);

-- Tenant scope may READ product-level rows (tenant_id IS NULL) of its product, but never WRITE them
-- (security review finding SR-02). Before this migration the single `scope` policy of each table used
-- axentra_scope_allows in USING and WITH CHECK, so a tenant-bound transaction could insert, update,
-- re-home (tenant_id NULL -> own tenant) or delete product-level rows such as product-wide API keys,
-- custom roles, schedules or webhooks.
--
-- axentra_scope_allows (read side) is unchanged. axentra_scope_allows_write is the write side: in
-- tenant scope it requires t = the current tenant (NULL is refused); platform and product scope are
-- unchanged. Every table that uses axentra_scope_allows gets:
--   * the `scope` policy's WITH CHECK switched to the write function (INSERT, and the new row of an
--     UPDATE), and
--   * two RESTRICTIVE policies, `scope_update` and `scope_delete`, whose USING is the write function,
--     so UPDATE and DELETE (and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE / FOR SHARE) in tenant scope only reach rows of
--     the current tenant. Restrictive policies are AND-ed with `scope`; SELECT is not affected.
-- Tables that store only product-level rows pass NULL as the tenant (products, product members,
-- roles, meters, plans, templates, product permissions, access definitions): they are read-only in
-- tenant scope from now on.

CREATE FUNCTION axentra_scope_allows_write(p text, t text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE AS $$
    SELECT CASE current_setting('axentra.scope', true)
        WHEN 'platform' THEN true
        WHEN 'product' THEN p IS NOT NULL AND p = current_setting('axentra.product_id', true)
        WHEN 'tenant' THEN p IS NOT NULL AND p = current_setting('axentra.product_id', true)
            AND t IS NOT NULL AND t = current_setting('axentra.tenant_id', true)
        ELSE false
    END
$$;

DO $$
DECLARE
    -- table, product expression, tenant expression (as in the table's `scope` policy)
    spec text[];
    specs text[][] := ARRAY[
        ['axentra_products', 'id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_product_members', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_tenants', 'product_id', 'id'],
        ['axentra_memberships', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_invitations', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_roles', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_api_keys', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_records', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_jobs', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_schedules', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_schedule_firings', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_events', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_webhook_endpoints', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_webhook_deliveries', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_files', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_storage_quotas', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_storage_usage', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_usage_meters', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_usage_events', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_usage_counters', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_usage_quotas', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_usage_reservations', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_billing_plans', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_billing_subscriptions', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_billing_overrides', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_notify_templates', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_notify_messages', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_notify_mailbox', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_notify_preferences', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_search_documents', 'product_id', 'tenant_id'],
        ['axentra_product_permissions', 'product_id', 'NULL'],
        ['axentra_access_definitions', 'product_id', 'NULL']
    ];
    w text;
BEGIN
    FOREACH spec SLICE 1 IN ARRAY specs LOOP
        w := format('axentra_scope_allows_write(%s, %s)', spec[2], spec[3]);
        EXECUTE format('ALTER POLICY scope ON %I WITH CHECK (%s)', spec[1], w);
        EXECUTE format('CREATE POLICY scope_update ON %I AS RESTRICTIVE FOR UPDATE USING (%s)', spec[1], w);
        EXECUTE format('CREATE POLICY scope_delete ON %I AS RESTRICTIVE FOR DELETE USING (%s)', spec[1], w);
    END LOOP;
END
$$;

-- axentra_account_tokens holds single-use tokens sent by email: only the SHA-256 of the token is

-- reader and writer.
--
-- axentra_users.email_verified_at records when the user proved control of their address (an
-- email verification link, or a password reset link, which also arrives by email).

CREATE TABLE axentra_account_tokens (
    id text PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES axentra_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    purpose text NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('password_reset', 'email_verification')),
    token_hash text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email text NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    used_at timestamptz
);
CREATE INDEX axentra_account_tokens_open ON axentra_account_tokens (user_id, purpose)
    WHERE used_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE axentra_users ADD COLUMN email_verified_at timestamptz;

-- axentra:no-transaction
-- Record lists sorted by time (sort=created_at / updated_at, ascending or descending) read one
-- collection of one tenant in time order. Without these indexes PostgreSQL sorted every record of
-- the collection before returning the first page. Built CONCURRENTLY so existing installations keep
-- writing records during the upgrade; IF NOT EXISTS makes a rerun after an interruption safe (an
-- interrupted concurrent build can leave an INVALID index behind: drop it and run `axentra migrate`
-- again, see docs/architecture/DATA.md).
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS axentra_records_created
    ON axentra_records (product_id, tenant_id, collection, created_at, id);
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS axentra_records_updated
    ON axentra_records (product_id, tenant_id, collection, updated_at, id);
